The reporting group beneficially owns exactly 6.4% of the issuer's outstanding shares, and this figure includes cash-settled positions that must be included in the calculation. My reconciliation spreadsheet was completed after the draft circulated and has not yet been attached to the filing package.

transcript.text: I reviewed the securities team's call notes and confirmed that the reporting group discussed seeking a board seat with the issuer's largest shareholder. This discussion occurred after the draft was circulated, and I have not yet updated the filing classification or purpose section. A board seat discussion is inconsistent with a passive-investment position and likely means we cannot file on Schedule 13G -- we may need to reclassify to Schedule 13D.

decisions.purpose_statement: Acquisition of shares for investment purposes; however, the reporting group has discussed seeking a board seat with the issuer's largest shareholder, which is inconsistent with a passive-investment position under Schedule 13G. The purpose of the transaction and any plans or proposals regarding the issuer's management, board, or corporate structure will be disclosed in accordance with Schedule 13D requirements.

commitments.detail: Update the filing classification from Schedule 13G to Schedule 13D and revise the purpose section to reflect the board seat discussion and any plans or proposals as required by Schedule 13D.

Attach the completed reconciliation spreadsheet showing 6.4% beneficial ownership, including cash-settled positions, to the revised filing package and update the beneficial-ownership percentage in the filing.
